intent: tactile button with Ben-Day dot halftone pattern
notes: press effect is immediate with 2px transform; keyboard focus is a 2px focus-ring outline offset off the edge, shipped with the component rather than left to the host page

intent: pick-one segmented mode selector of joined square cells on a shared rule
useWhen: choosing exactly one mode from a small fixed set
avoid: dropdowns, loose toggle buttons, and animated tab sliders
reducedMotion: unaffected — the switch is immediate by contract; there is no transition or slide to suppress, so no rest frame is required
notes: selected-state contract for a pick-one control: the selected cell inverts the unselected treatment (solid ink + paper text against paper + ink text) and switching is immediate; generalises the theme-switch tabs' joined-cells + heavy-bottom-edge shape as a reusable class decoupled from the theming machinery

intent: pick-an-action menu whose paper height grows under its invoker around fixed items
useWhen: a button offers a short list of actions on the same object
avoid: using it as a select control for a value, a drop shadow or rounded corner under it, a chevron glyph on the invoker, or a script to open it
notes: composes motion.reveal.stepped-height; content never staggers independently. rides the platform popover attribute with a popovertarget invoker, so it needs no script and gets light-dismiss and top-layer stacking from the platform. anchored with CSS anchor positioning; where a browser lacks anchor support the popover keeps its default top-layer centring — degraded placement, not a broken control. the invoker's affordance is a solid square in the pill-dot convention, not a chevron.

intent: short opaque-paper annotation whose height grows around fixed lines
useWhen: a term or control needs a sentence or two of explanation in place
avoid: hover-triggered tooltips, paragraphs of body copy, or anything the reader must act on — a note explains, it does not ask
notes: composes motion.reveal.stepped-height; content never staggers independently. same platform popover mechanism and the same anchor-positioning caveat as component.menu.dropdown. opaque warm paper plus an accent left rule marks it as spoken-for paper rather than a translucent wash or floating card; it carries no drop shadow, per the anti-goals.

intent: sheet laid over the page on the top layer, its height growing around fixed rows
useWhen: a decision or a confirmation needs the reader's whole attention without leaving the page
avoid: reaching for it where a note or a fold would do; stacking one sheet over another; a rounded or shadowed panel
notes: composes motion.reveal.stepped-height; content never staggers independently. IT IS NOT A MODAL: built on the platform popover attribute, it light-dismisses but does not trap focus and its backdrop is not inert, so a reader can still tab into the page behind it. a consumer who needs a true modal keeps these classes and mounts them on a dialog element opened with showModal(), which supplies the focus trap and the inert backdrop the popover cannot. the backdrop is an ink wash, not a blur.

intent: in-place fold whose body height grows around fixed lines when it opens
useWhen: secondary detail belongs on the page but should not compete with it until asked for
avoid: hiding anything the reader needs to complete the task, nesting folds, or a rotating chevron affordance
notes: composes motion.reveal.stepped-height; content never staggers independently. rides the details element's own open state, so it needs no script and keeps the platform's built-in semantics. the sign is two hairline rules — a plus that loses its upright to become a minus — because this system draws its marks as rules and dots.
